content.value_statement: Story and profile cards often need consistent layouts, respectful cultural cues, and clear AI labeling. This skill gives component patterns, data mapping, and AI enrichment guidance for Empathy Ledger card interfaces.
actual_capabilities: Defines data fields and priority tiers for storyteller card displays.
Documents default, compact, featured, list, mini, and profile card variants.
Provides UI patterns for badges, quotes, metrics, loading states, and empty states.
Describes AI enrichment flows for bios, quotes, themes, connections, and summaries.
Includes SQL schema examples and internal API patterns for enrichment data.
Gives consent dashboard patterns for status badges, tokens, charts, and revocation dialogs.
limitations: The skill is documentation and does not ship runnable component source files.
Examples assume the Empathy Ledger data model and a React style component stack.
It does not implement backend AI services, authorization, or consent policy enforcement.
Production use still needs review by cultural stakeholders and product owners.

use_cases.title: Create a storyteller directory card
use_cases.description: Use the data hierarchy and visual specifications to design a reusable profile card with respectful cultural context.

use_cases.title: Plan AI enrichment displays
use_cases.description: Map enriched bios, extracted quotes, themes, and suggested connections into clear card and profile states.

use_cases.title: Review consent dashboard components
use_cases.description: Use the syndication patterns to design consent status, token masking, analytics, and revocation flows.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a card variant
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the design-component skill to recommend a storyteller card variant for a mobile directory. Include required fields, optional fields, and fallback states.

prompt_templates.title: Draft component requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the design-component skill to write requirements for a featured storyteller card. Cover layout, badges, quote display, accessibility, and dark mode.

prompt_templates.title: Add AI enrichment indicators
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the design-component skill to add AI enrichment states to an existing profile card. Include labels, user override behavior, and sacred content limits.

prompt_templates.title: Design consent management UI
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the design-component skill to design a syndication consent dashboard. Include status badges, token masking, analytics charts, and revocation confirmation copy.

output_examples.input: A product team needs a compact card for sidebar mentions.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend the compact variant, a small avatar, display name, story count, elder badge, initials fallback, and keyboard focus support.

output_examples.input: A designer wants to show AI-generated theme expertise on a featured profile.
output_examples.output: The skill would outline theme badges, depth indicators, clear AI labeling, manual override options, and limits for sacred or restricted content.

output_examples.input: A safety reviewer needs consent revocation guidance.
output_examples.output: The skill would produce a dialog structure with clear consequences, reversible-control messaging, optional reason capture, and a destructive action style.

best_practices: Show cultural background, elder status, and traditional territory only with respectful labels and clear context.
Mark AI-generated content clearly and keep storyteller override controls visible.
Use loading, empty, hover, focus, and dark mode states for every card variant.
anti_patterns: Do not auto-publish AI-generated summaries, quotes, or tags without review.
Do not extract or display sacred content in public or external sharing interfaces.
Do not create multiple card variants with inconsistent fields, colors, and accessibility behavior.

faq.question: What does this skill help design?
faq.answer: It helps design storyteller cards, story cards, profile displays, AI enrichment states, and consent dashboard components.

faq.question: Does it generate complete React components?
faq.answer: No. It provides patterns, examples, data mapping, and requirements that developers can apply in an existing app.

faq.question: Can it help with AI-generated profile content?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers enriched bios, quote extraction, theme expertise, summaries, connection suggestions, and clear AI labeling.

faq.question: Is the guidance specific to Empathy Ledger?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples use Empathy Ledger data fields, cultural context, and consent management workflows.

faq.question: How does it address cultural sensitivity?
faq.answer: It recommends respectful terminology, elder status display, traditional territory acknowledgement, sacred content limits, and storyteller control.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
